items.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
items.summary: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

items.title: Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down, Noel Kimmel named successor
items.summary: Asch is stepping down as head of the institutional prime brokerage.

items.title: Bitcoin breaks with stocks, declines as ETF outflows mount, MARA reduces holdings
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 10, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin lags stock rebound in advance of U.S. inflation report
items.summary: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

items.title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
items.summary: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin adds to losses after disappointing inflation data
items.summary: A rate hike in December appears totally assured now, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

items.title: The crypto wallet that grew up inside Telegram is striking out on its own
items.summary: The app will offer crypto trading, tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, and perpetual futures, all already available through Telegram.

items.title: Coinbase, Kalshi, Kraken parent back CFTC in legal fight over stock perpetual futures
items.summary: The Capital Markets Alliance argues that the products fall under the Securities and Exchange Commission’s jurisdiction.

items.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
items.summary: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

items.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
items.summary: MARA paid off every loan backed by its bitcoin and says the rest of its coins can fund AI datacenters.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
items.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

items.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
items.summary: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

items.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
items.summary: Trading volume on Polymarket’s US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.

items.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
items.summary: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

items.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
items.summary: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
items.summary: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.

items.title: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says
items.summary: Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike.

items.title: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
items.summary: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.

items.title: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
items.summary: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.

items.title: Elon Musk Calls Claude Opus 5.5 a 'Masterpiece', Admits Grok 4.8 Won't Match It
items.summary: Elon Musk says the incoming Grok 4.8 will trail Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5, praising his rival’s model while predicting Grok 5 could surpass it in two or three months.

items.title: Grayscale Bets $1 Million on Zcash as Privacy Coin Tumbles
items.summary: Grayscale plans to direct $1 million from its Zcash ETF fees to ecosystem nonprofits and launched a national ad campaign, as ZEC fell more than 11%.

items.title: Goldman, Citi and Global Banks Commit $270 Million to Challenge Crypto’s Stablecoin Giants
items.summary: The funding, backing a U.S.-incorporated issuer codenamed “Project Faro,” covers five years of operations as traditional lenders move to challenge crypto-native giants Tether and Circle.

items.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot US Inflation Fuels Fears of Bigger Fed Rate Hike
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $74,000 after October inflation beat forecasts, increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise rates again at its December meeting.

items.title: Solana's Jupiter Expands Beyond Trading With Token Baskets, Yield Vaults and New Portfolio
items.summary: The trading platform, which says it has routed more than $1.3 trillion in trades, is launching four products ahead of Solana Breakpoint.

items.title: Decrypt Money Account Gets Confidential Transfers With Solana Privacy Firm Helius
items.summary: Helius' Solana Privacy Rings will let Decrypt users send funds without broadcasting amounts, as it grows out The Information Exchange.

items.title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Range at $70 to $78, Valuing Company at Up to $1.4 Trillion
items.summary: The Claude developer is also lining up $26 billion from Nvidia, Google and other tech giants in a private placement alongside the listing.

items.title: Moody’s Taps Chainlink to Send Credit Ratings Across Multiple Blockchains
items.summary: The testnet pilot used Chainlink’s CCIP to distribute Moody’s ratings simultaneously across permissioned and permissionless blockchains, while preserving the firm’s existing publication and governance processes.

items.title: Morning Minute: Vitalik Recasts ETH as a Store of Value
items.summary: It’s a big shift for Ethereum from the “ultrasound money” days. But can ETH compete as a store-of-value play?

items.title: Binance Warns of Apple iOS Flaw That Could Expose iPhone Users' Private Keys
items.summary: Apple has not publicly confirmed the "worse_query" bug, which a researcher published days before its latest iOS security update.
